_comment: The laptop shop (M2). Orders are paid when placed and arrive after the supplier's lead time, one truck at the curb at a time. A van waits wait_minutes to be unloaded; a tanker pumps into a fill coupling standing at or right of curb_x. Goods that are not taken go back for a return fee of the larger of minimum and share of their value. Prices are per unit: price when given, else the equipment's cost for a crate, else unit_g times the material's buy price in workshop.json. The clock runs minutes_per_second game minutes per real second from start_minute (Day 1 08:00).

suppliers.name: Hollis Family Farm
suppliers.blurb: Third-generation beet growers. Grandma Hollis still checks every sack by hand and judges your posture.

suppliers.name: Calcium & Sons
suppliers.blurb: Slaked lime since 1911. Every bag says DO NOT GET IN EYES in four languages, twice, in capitals.

suppliers.name: SweetCo Wholesale
suppliers.blurb: Sugar by the sack. Their slogan, "Probably Not Sand", tested surprisingly well.

suppliers.name: Brackwater Haulage
suppliers.blurb: Fresh from the bay, give or take a jellyfish. Bulk comes by tanker: have a fill coupling by the road, the driver does not do buckets.

suppliers.name: Pipe Dreams Plumbing & Steel
suppliers.blurb: If it holds liquid, they sell it. If it holds liquid badly, they sell it cheaper. All sales final, all leaks yours.
